notes: Strip x 0-1540 plus overlap to x 1840. Streets: Elberon Avenue (west edge, later diagonal SE), Purcell Avenue, Considine Avenue, Hawthorne Avenue (N-S); West 8th Street (top), Phillips Avenue, Bassett Road, Cameron Place (three jogged sections), Murdock Avenue, Moulton Avenue. Considine's lower label reads 'CONSIDINE' followed by a Y-like mark (could be read 'CONSIDINEY'); 'AVE' is printed on it near y 700, recorded as Considine Avenue. Purcell shows '60'' near its bend (x 724, y 4438) besides the 50' at the top. The '40'' printed at (1450,5272) in the unnamed south leg may be its width. Not picked: alleys at x~1407 (15', south of W 8th), x~1440 (25', south of Cameron Place), x~1705 (15', south of Murdock) and y~5692 (x 1720-1990); the grey/teal/orange/yellow subdivision bands; the streetcar tracks in Elberon. Kansas Avenue runs along the plate's bottom edge from x~1830 y~6240 eastward; a narrow strip between a lot line and the plate edge runs from there NW to Elberon at about (1610,5830) and may be Kansas Avenue's continuation, but no name is printed on it, so no junction was picked. Hawthorne Place (proposed) lies at x~1950, outside the overlap. Spaced diagonal lettering 'STEWARD RD.' (and further lettering continuing NE across Hawthorne near y 1250-1700) is printed over the lots in block 7 with no street lines drawn; treated as an old/vacated road name, not a street.
